subject: URGENT — cannot log in, account locked
body: Hi, I have been completely locked out of my account since yesterday morning. I tried the password reset but the email never arrived. I have an important client meeting in 2 hours and absolutely need access to my files. I have tried three times now. Please help immediately.

subject: Question about my invoice for June
body: Hello, I noticed that my invoice for June shows a charge of $149 but I thought my plan was $99 per month. Could you please explain what the extra $50 is for? I don't recall agreeing to any upgrade. Thanks.

subject: Would love a dark mode option
body: Hey team! Love the product. One thing that would make it even better — a dark mode for the dashboard. I use it late at night and the bright screen is a bit much. Not urgent at all, just a thought. Keep up the great work!

subject: Export to CSV is broken — data missing
body: When I export my report to CSV the date column is completely empty. This has been happening for the past three days across different browsers (Chrome and Firefox). I rely on this export for a weekly report I send to my manager. The rest of the data looks fine but the missing dates make the file useless.
